Bug_Title: Synchronization should not be done on instances of value-based classes
Bug_Explanation: The bug is that synchronization is being done on instances of value-based classes (Integer). This can cause unrelated threads to deadlock with unclear stacktraces as the JVM fails to correctly synchronize threads on these types.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case creates two threads that will try to synchronize on the same Integer objects. Due to the bug in the SynchronizationBug class, this can cause unrelated threads to deadlock with unclear stacktraces. Since the two threads are synchronizing on the same Integer objects, this test will fail due to the bug. If the bug is fixed, this test will pass.
Bug_Trigger_Explanation: The test ran successfully without any failures, which indicates that the synchronization on the Integer instances did not cause any issues. However, this does not guarantee that the synchronization is correct or efficient, only that it did not cause an immediate failure in the test environment. Further investigation or more comprehensive testing may be necessary to fully evaluate the synchronization mechanism.
